Kuvitus: keittiön liedellä kattila, joss: Illustration: a pan on a kitchen hob with water boiling vigorously. The hotplate glows red and energy keeps flowing from it into the pan. There are bubbles in the water and steam rises from it. The column of a thermometer dipped in the water stays at the same height.
Kuvitus: järvi jäätyy alkutalvella. Rann: Illustration: a lake freezing in early winter. Near the shore there is already a thin cover of ice, farther out the water is still liquid, and there is the first snow on the shore.
Mikromalli, kaavakuva: kiinteässä ainees: Micro model, schematic diagram: in a solid the particles are bound to each other in a regular arrangement, in a liquid they are disordered but still in contact, and in a gas they are far apart and move freely. Arrows: the solid melts into a liquid, the liquid vaporises into a gas.
Veden lämpenemiskäyrä, kaavakuva: lämpöt: Heating curve of water, schematic diagram: temperature as a function of the energy transferred Q. Ice warms up steeply, melts on a horizontal part at 0 degrees (Q = sm), water warms up more gently from 0 to 100 degrees, boils on a long horizontal part at 100 degrees (Q = rm) and steam warms up steeply. The parts for ice and steam are about twice as steep as the part for water; the lengths of the horizontal parts are not to scale.
Faasikaavio, kaavakuva: paine p lämpötil: Phase diagram, schematic diagram: pressure p as a function of temperature T. The curves separate the solid, liquid and gas regions and meet at the triple point. At atmospheric pressure, water boils at 100 degrees; on a mountain the pressure is lower and the boiling point is lower.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: jääpalan lämmityk: Graph to scale: when a piece of ice is heated, the temperature T of the ice in degrees Celsius as a function of the energy transferred Q in kilojoules. The temperature rises from the point (0 kJ; −16 °C) to the point (20 kJ; 0 °C), stays at 0 °C up to the point (220 kJ; 0 °C) and then rises more gently. The grid spacing is 20 kJ and 10 °C.
